tagline: You hold the reins. The agent does the work.
brief: An AI finance agent that pays bills, manages subscriptions and protects prepaid packages, acting only inside rules the user signs. It should feel in control, calm and precise, the opposite of flashy crypto and generic AI branding.
criteria: Success: avoids fintech cliches (shields, locks, arrows, blue), reads at 16 px, works in one colour, owns the lime and ink palette.

concepts.name: Taut R
concepts.idea: The R's leg is pulled taut into a rein: you hold the line.
rationale: Ties straight to the product promise: the user holds the reins
One stroke weight, one radius, exact 60 degree leg
Lime on ink app icon stands out from blue fintech icons

recommendation: Taut R in lime on ink for app and dark surfaces, ink on light everywhere else. Lime is never used on white.
next_steps: Trademark search on name and mark
Wire favicon and PWA icons into the Next.js app
Swap the placeholder logo in the canvas and Figma mockups
